name: vita-save-sync
description: Keep your PSP saves in sync between a PS Vita (VitaShell FTP) and PPSSPP on Windows.
long_description: Play a PSP game on the Vita, carry on in PPSSPP on your PC, then go back to the Vita. Vita Save Sync copies each save to the side where it's out of date. It connects to the Vita over Wi‑Fi through VitaShell's built-in FTP server, so you don't need a USB cable.
